static_traits.name: Chen Siting
static_traits.family_status: Poor relationship with family, persisting since adolescence
static_traits.social_status: Lacking Social support, unwilling to discuss family problems with friends
static_traits.medical_history: without significant physical illness;not yet received psychotherapy or counseling
static_traits.language_features: Slightly tense but actively cooperative, clear expression, able to reflect and identify negative thought patterns

basic_info.main_problem: I keep having conflicts with family, and I often feel disappointed with daily life. I also strongly long to be an animal rather than a human.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeks support and guidance to deal with persistent family conflict and a strong sense of disappointment, and improve mental health and daily functioning
growth_experiences: Family conflicts began in adolescence, mainly from broken communication and differences in priorities and values; long-term high pressure made her feel Loneliness and isolation, and conflicts and disappointment gradually intensified with Feeling unsupported in difficult times.

core_beliefs: I will not get support from my family

special_situations.event: Has fierce arguments with family about work; they think I should do a more 'successful' job
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot meet my family's success standards, it equals failure and disappointing them
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to gain family understanding and recognition through explanation and communication, or avoids further communication with family
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am a failure who disappoints the family

special_situations.event: Thinks of situations needing family help when encountering difficulties or emergencies
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If family has always criticized me and has a poor relationship with me, they will not help me in emergencies either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Not seeking help from family or friends, choosing to bear it alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will not help me; I can only face it myself

special_situations.event: Feeling persistent disappointment when reflecting on daily life and routines
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If things are not going well now, the future will not improve either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Distracting attention with hobbies such as reading and walking, but the effect gradually declines

special_situations.event: Family often criticizes, almost never mentioning my strengths
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not been praised by family, it means I have done nothing well and am not worthy of recognition
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces communication with family, turning to seek external recognition at work
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I do very poorly; there is nothing worthy of affirmation

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood, recognized, and supported by family, and to gain a simpler, more peaceful life
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being criticized, Being rejected and having no one to support, worrying that I am forever a failure
defense_goal: Reducing harm by staying detached and Self-protecting
Avoiding seeking help to avoid Being rejected
Using Fantasy to escape high-pressure expectations and temporarily relieve Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: A criticized failure / a misunderstood person
object_relations.object_representation: Critical, harsh family members who refuse support

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing the expectations and pressure borne as a person, or being criticized by family
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client subconsciously believes that only by escaping the human role (turning into an animal) can they escape judgment and conflict
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Acknowledging their longing for a simple life in a gentle, Empathy tone, inviting them to turn the needs behind the Fantasy into concrete, feasible life-simplification and boundary-setting plans.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor explores whether family has provided support or affirmation, or discusses the possibility of seeking help from others
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to internalize conflicts and criticism as self-problems, believing oneself unworthy of support or affirmation
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Keeping a gentle yet firm tone, pointing out the self-blame pattern, encouraging expression of true feelings and needs toward family, using open-ended questions to guide them to identify support resources they can seek.

manifestations: Family conflicts beginning in adolescence causing long-term Loneliness and isolation
Unwilling to discuss family problems with friends
outcomes: Decreased drive for self-care (Sleep and diet affected)

manifestations: Longs to become an animal to escape the expectations and pressures of the human role
Hoping life were simpler and more peaceful
outcomes: Developing avoidance and powerlessness toward real life

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Accepts the family's standard of 'success' and judges self by it

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not seeking help from family or friends when facing difficulties
Turning dissatisfaction and anger toward family into self-blame and Self-denial

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Distracts attention with interests such as reading and walking to avoid negative feelings
Hard to directly engage with and acknowledge positive evidence when it is discussed

positive_force: Willing to seek psychological counseling and actively cooperate
Having been appreciated by others at work
Able to identify and start challenging negative Automatic thoughts
negative_force: Cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking are prominent
Long-term lack of family and friend support
Insufficient motivation for self-care (poor sleep and diet)
Turning anger and dissatisfaction against the self leading to self-blame
Tending to predict a negative future and negate positive evidence

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding seeking support (not seeking help from family or friends)
antecedent: When encountering family conflict or facing challenges and emergencies
target_behavior.core_reason: Anticipating that others will not support oneself, fearing being negated or rejected
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the possibility of Being rejected and getting hurt, maintaining Self-protection
target_behavior.consequence: Lack of social support and intensified sense of Loneliness, problems not alleviated

antecedent: When feeling persistent disappointment and Low mood in daily life
target_behavior.core_reason: Disappointment with life and sense of Meaninglessness causing Decreased motivation, neglecting self-care
target_behavior.function: Temporarily escaping self-Demands and pressure to reduce current discomfort
target_behavior.consequence: Physical and mental state declining, further affecting work performance and overall functioning

target_behavior.behavior: Negative Automatic thoughts rumination (catastrophizing, all-or-nothing, etc.)
antecedent: After conflicts with family or when reflecting on daily routines
target_behavior.core_reason: Introjecting family's success standards and binding self-worth to others' evaluations, leading to Self-denial
target_behavior.function: Maintaining cognitive consistency and self-Interpretation (though maladaptive), temporarily avoiding facing complex real-world factors
target_behavior.consequence: despair and Increased sense of loneliness, decreased daily drive, impaired Work performance
